regime_context: Hong Kong theme leadership is narrow and concentrated in Banks (rank 1, crowded, mean-revert Hurst tag) with Energy as challenger (trend tag). emerging_watch: Watching whether Banks (H + HK) retains rank 1 despite its crowded flag and mean-revert Hurst tag; if Energy (H-shares) closes the margin to under 0.10 while both remain eligible, leadership handoff confirmation would be signaled.
